# How to Acknowledge an Email

## Simple Acknowledgment Templates

### Short & Professional
> "Thank you for your email. Noted."

> "Received, thank you!"

> "Thank you for the update."

---

### Acknowledging with Action
> "Thank you for your email. I will review and get back to you by [date]."

> "Got it, thanks! I'll look into this and follow up shortly."

> "Thank you for sending this over. I'll take care of it."

---

### Acknowledging Information
> "Thank you for the information. Much appreciated."

> "Noted with thanks."

> "Thank you for letting me know."

---

### Acknowledging a Task/Request
> "Thank you for your email. I'm on it."

> "Received. I will have this completed by [deadline]."

> "Thanks for reaching out. I'll work on this and keep you updated."

---

## Tips
- **Reply promptly** – ideally within 24 hours
- **Keep it brief** – no need for a long response
- **Mention next steps** if action is required
- **Match the tone** of the sender (formal or casual)
- **Use the sender's name** for a personal touch
- **Include a timeline** if they're waiting on you

---

Would you like a template tailored to a specific situation?
